applicabilityBasis.summary: reUSD is a senior NAV-based reinsurance capital token. Its purchase agreement characterizes it as derivative tranched debt under BVI law, restricts noteholder rights to registered eligible holders and does not require the issuer to maintain redemption liquidity. Current product documentation describes repayment in the deposit asset at the accrued price. These facts do not establish the GENIUS fixed-monetary-value obligation or a U.S. securities/deposit exclusion; applicability remains uncertain pending qualified token-specific legal analysis.

genius.notes: Retain the October 1, 2026 applicability withdrawal: a qualified U.S. token-specific legal determination remains unavailable, so derivative-debt status under BVI law, NAV accrual and non-U.S. distribution terms are not promoted to a categorical U.S. exclusion. Resilience (BVI) Ltd remains the issuer named by the reUSD purchase agreement; Cayman foundation/operator, Cayman SPC custody and licensed reinsurer are separate roles. The purchase agreement prohibits U.S. persons, describes offerings under securities exemptions/safe harbors, links token value to senior-class NAV and disclaims an obligation to maintain redemption liquidity. Current documentation describes accrued-price deposit-asset repayment with buffers/queues. No GENIUS issuer approval, state qualification, official application or foreign registration was found in the bounded dated public-source review. DASP not-yet-restricted describes federal timing only, not U.S. distribution eligibility. The former historical enforcement observation is refreshed by exact-name indexed OCC/SEC/FDIC/NCUA/NYDFS searches, with no public action found and no exhaustive non-indexed database claim. Metrics disclose reserve/portfolio data; the October 2025 Network Firm AUP and ongoing proof claims do not demonstrate publicly available monthly independent GENIUS reserve assurance. Independent verification used issuer markdown/PDF sources and isolated Chromium for the OCC pending-bank-application and BMA tables. Indexed enforcement searches located no matching SEC, OCC, NYDFS or FDIC action; these limited searches do not establish the absence of private or non-public proceedings.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: On 2026-10-07, no public GENIUS issuer approval, state qualification, official pending application or registered foreign exception naming Resilience (BVI) Ltd for reUSD was found in the inspected directories, rulemaking materials, issuer disclosures and targeted regulator-domain searches. The OCC table concerns pending bank licensing, and NYDFS listings concern existing state licenses; neither is a complete GENIUS approval census. Rulemaking is pre-effective; absence does not establish illegality, refusal or absence of non-public applications. Token applicability remains independently unresolved.
